title: User Authentication, Session Security & Lockout
acceptance_criteria: Passwords hashed with bcrypt; server-side session token revoked on logout; 30-min idle timeout; account locked after 5 failed login attempts with 423 status returned on 6th attempt; all events audited.

title: Secure Document Intake, Validation & Deduplication
req_IDs: AICMS-F-001, AICMS-F-002, AICMS-F-003, AICMS-F-004, AICMS-SR-002, AICMS-SR-004
acceptance_criteria: Accepts PDF, DOCX, TXT <= 20MB; validates extension and magic bytes; rejects disguised files; computes SHA-256 and returns 409 on duplicate upload; tracks QUEUED/PROCESSING/COMPLETED/FAILED lifecycle.

title: Document Parsing and Author/Title Metadata Extraction
acceptance_criteria: Extracts full text and native metadata (title, author, creation date) across supported formats; missing metadata stays null/empty; parser runs in bounded execution sandbox; OCR routing fallback provided.

title: AI Semantic Embeddings, Categorization & Keyword Extraction
acceptance_criteria: Generates 384-dim embeddings via all-MiniLM-L6-v2; categorizes text using classifier with confidence score; extracts 5-10 keywords via TF-IDF/keyphrase; stores model name and version; supports simulated failure flags.

title: Vector Indexing, Semantic Search & Access Control Filter
req_IDs: AICMS-F-011, AICMS-F-012, AICMS-F-013, AICMS-F-014, AICMS-F-015, AICMS-SR-005, AICMS-NF-001
acceptance_criteria: Indexes document embeddings in vector store; converts natural language query into embedding; ranks by cosine similarity; strictly performs user authorization before returning snippet/title (ADR-002); supports category/file-type filters, pagination, and empty state.
linked_TCs: TC-IDX-01, TC-SR-01, TC-SR-02, TC-SR-03, TC-SR-04, TC-SEC-05

title: Metadata Review, Editing & Optimistic Concurrency Control
acceptance_criteria: Authorized users can view and edit title, author, category, keywords; AI-generated items clearly labelled; PATCH with version revision checks detects conflicts and returns 409; logs revision history in audit log.

title: Category Taxonomy Management & Collection Re-Indexing
acceptance_criteria: Admin can perform CRUD on category taxonomy; re-indexing job endpoint triggers batch re-embedding with unique job_id and queryable progress status.

title: Secure Document Deletion & Vector Purge
acceptance_criteria: Deleting a document purges stored file, database metadata, vector index embeddings, and permission entries; emits audit event; purged documents immediately disappear from search.

title: System Observability, Performance Metrics & Audit Logs
acceptance_criteria: Admin/Auditor metrics endpoint exposes ingestion counts, error rates, p50/p90 latency, and queue depth without leaking document content; structured correlation-ID logs; data reconciliation script.

title: Frontend Web Application & WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility
acceptance_criteria: React dashboard with Login, Live Ingestion Queue, Semantic Search with snippets, Document Viewer/Editor, and Admin Console; keyboard navigable, visible focus, ARIA tags, contrast compliant.

title: API Hardening, Rate Limiting & TLS Termination
acceptance_criteria: Rate limiting (429 Too Many Requests); standardized error format {code, message, correlation_id}; TLS reverse proxy with dev certificate; plain HTTP redirected.

title: Performance, Reliability & Scalability Validation
acceptance_criteria: Search latency p90 <= 3s under concurrent load; 10-page document ingestion <= 60s; async worker backoff and dead-letter handling measured and verified.

title: System Validation, Traceability Matrix & Test Report Generation
acceptance_criteria: Execute all 38 STP test cases with stored evidence; produce Unit Test Report, System Validation Report, Code Coverage Report (>=70%), and Branch Coverage Report (>=60%); RTM v2 finalized.
